title: Petition of H.T. Drummond, Inc., pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 7, to amend the Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity No. 3780, authorizing the operation of motor vehicles restricted to 15-passenger vans, for the carriage of passenger for hire in Pembroke, Hanover, Randolph, Scituate, Duxbury, Marshfield, and Boston, by adding the Towns of Plymouth and Kingston, and by adding certain public ways in Boston to the specified route.
